column1: # zobel1629 key (Johan Zobel, Paris 1629): index-switched number alphabets, found by the contributor from the ciphertext (issue #456, Malcolm McBratney).

# Each cipher word starts with an index number 28-39 that picks one of four alphabets; the letter figures are 4-27. Alphabet of 24 letters a b c d e f g h i k l m n o p q r s t u w x y z (i = j, u = v).
# status: rule = fixed by the table rule and seen in at least two words; seen = value read in the text; open = not seen, no value.
